text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
I have something to discuss regarding Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A proposal!
How about we try entering the Breeders' Cup?!"
choice_data_list: The Breeders' Cup...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Breeders' Cup is a major racing event held in the United States.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A world-class event where numerous GⅠ races are held at the same time.
No Japanese Umamusume has ever won here before.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA board of directors
has also expressed an eager desire for it.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want her to achieve a historic first for Japan?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! There are high expectations
for Espoir City, whom you raised.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Some believe that if anyone can do it, she can
conquer the pinnacle of classic distances...
and claim the BC Classic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The invitation was delightful, a moment that truly made her feel from the bottom of her heart how recognized Espoir City was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And for a newcomer like me, it was an honor far beyond what I deserved.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Will you take the offer,
Trainer <username>?
choice_data_list: ...Please let me take this home.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
Both Espoir City and you
will need time to prepare."
choice_data_list: I'll find the best path for her.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! What you and I wish for
is to draw out the maximum potential of the Umamusume
and help them grow so they can truly take flight!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...There are no other priorities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If only I were a veteran trainer
with twenty years under my belt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I would have traveled abroad with her without hesitation, confident that my knowledge would be useful.
And yet...
choice_data_list: Everything I have—is already inside her.
My everything—is already inside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...What I could teach her from here on out would only be superficial knowledge, not living wisdom.
choice_data_list: Espo is an Uma Musume who can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I want her to grow stronger.
I want to bear witness as she becomes the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's precisely because from the bottom of my heart,
I believe you're the strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I understand the situation.
I'll try reaching out to my overseas acquaintances as well.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, Trainer.
Who was that just now.
choice_data_list: She's a senior who'll be looking after you... probably.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe?!
That's pretty vague..."
choice_data_list: Espo, there's something important I need to tell you.
Espo, there's something important I need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Is this the next training schedule?
choice_data_list: Actually, you've got an offer to race overseas
Actually, you've got an offer to race overseas

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: An overseas expedition...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Falco's Dubai trip!?
Like I said, I'm not going...
choice_data_list: No, it's the Breeders' Cup in America.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The Breeders' Cup?! Huh?!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, that's surprising, isn't it?
Ahaha, that's pretty surprising, huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously!?
That's one of the craziest races in the whole world...
choice_data_list: —I want to make you win there.
—I want to make you win there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes for that.
Her "role as an educator" is—
choice_data_list: (To see them off.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What the hell is she thinking?
choice_data_list: You can become even stronger
You can become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It will.
It'll only grow even more.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Always have been, and always will be.
I'm one strong-ass Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're—
choice_data_list: Keep standing your ground, Espo!
Keep standing your ground, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're calling someone else because you "want to win"!? No way...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: If it weren't for you, everything up till now would—!
choice_data_list: Don't get so hung up on just one Trainer!
Don't get so hung up on just one Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Kh!
choice_data_list: From here on, you'll meet all kinds of people and learn so much
From here on, you'll meet all kinds of people and learn so much.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Don't let that experience and potential go to waste.
Don't let that experience and potential go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: To me, you're the strongest Uma Musume there is.
Because to me, you're the strongest Uma Musume there is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: I want to see you win, no matter what kind of race it is.
I want to see you win, no matter what kind of race it is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Are they stupid...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid...!
If you act that tough, I can't even...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I... I can choose now too...!
I'm free to choose for myself now, aren't I...!?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm strong enough of an Umamusume
that I don't even need a Trainer
bagging on me...!
choice_data_list: ――Thank you, Espo

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, we run counter-clockwise.
Starting 50 meters before the corner."
choice_data_list: Be careful not to drift wide at the start.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Is that all the instruction
she needs?
(Was that conversation really all the instructions?)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It appears so. Furthermore,
Trainer <username> is—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I made sure Espoir City understood why she needed
that training before going over the key points to watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I see... So building rapport
will be crucial...
(I see... getting "used to it" will be necessary.)"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The aura in that corner is unreal...!
Are all those people here to see Espo-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: No. I heard it wasn't Espo-san, but the Trainer who called.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: To confirm the principle of mutual generation in feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Stop using feng shui analogies and just say it normally! Wait, so... you mean you're checking our compatibility? Does that mean..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Espo-san, are you
parting ways with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hah,
who'd you hear that from?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I just asked what everyone thought
after watching Espo-san's recent training."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I haven't stood beside Espo-san
as a true rival yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Espo-san and her Trainer up close as her roommate,
I always thought... their relationship was in complete harmony.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure about this?
Isn't that person precious to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Don't act like you know everything.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, ever since she teamed up with her Trainer,
Espo-san has always been—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Because you're someone important to me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That guy told me...
'You're the strongest Umamusume who can win any race.'"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Then that's how I want it to look, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll answer with that feng shui you love so much, Rickey. Mutual generation means a relationship where we elevate each other, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Then if we ain't pushin' each other to be better, it's not right, is it?
Even if we don't gotta walk on eggshells around each other."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I am a horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...She's an Umamusume who can become the strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, she's probably thinking it through too.
She's not gonna get reeled in by someone with just an empty title.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
She's trying to figure it out too.
...Including whether 'she herself isn't good enough.'

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...
Is that what you want, Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter.
...A strong Umamusume's just gotta climb to the top, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I holed myself up in the trainer's office,
researching overseas races and prominent trainers
until the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So... I was tired.
I think that's why I ended up calling you."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "What is it, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Wanna go grab some ramen?
Wanna go grab some ramen?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ramen, you say... You bastard...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll go! I'm coming with!
Just you wait! And you're paying, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, Rickey!
I'm stepping out for a bit!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tell 'em I won't be needin' dinner at the dorm!
I'll be back by curfew! Thanks, leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Um, well...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Off you go!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haah... Trainer,
ramen for dinner, really...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If we're gonna eat, might as well make it good.
Something salty and piping hot.
With an extra seasoned egg too.
choice_data_list: You just casually added extra toppings too, huh.
You just casually added extra toppings too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You could stand to be a little more open-minded. I'm keeping you company here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...They left.
The two of them.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even an outing at night like this
felt like just a normal day for the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —May the two of them share a blissful night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the materials were gradually coming together.
I wanted to tell her as soon as possible.
choice_data_list: (Because tonight is Christmas.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For as long as I can remain someone who can give her gifts, I want to fulfill that role to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—I see.
So this is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Your handwriting looks just like you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Serious, uptight... and a little annoying.
choice_data_list: ...What kind of kanji even counts as 'annoying'?
...What kind of kanji is considered 'annoying'?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's things like that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...For now, I'll take it.
I'll decide after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's satisfied with the current plan.
I let out a soft sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: Oh, and also! Today is Christmas, so—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...A Christmas present?
From you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, addressed to the coolest and strongest of them all—you.
Yeah, addressed to the coolest and strongest person—you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That kind of stuff is annoying, too.
......

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Inside are... shoelaces, huh.
choice_data_list: Because you're cool right down to your toes.
Because you're cool right down to your toes.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...
Seriously, you really are...
choice_data_list: I wanted to give you a present that suits you
I wanted to find a gift that suits you perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaargh!!
Are you freaking kidding meeeeee?!
choice_data_list: Espo!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait there! Right there!
Don't you dare move!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How the hell can you call yourself a strong Umamusume
if you're always just on the receiving end?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—'Scuse me!
Do you sell paper and pens here!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Something nice! Something that'll last forever!
I want really sturdy paper!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—As if I'd let it end without giving anything back!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Like hell I'll be an Umamusume who can't pay back what you've given me!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (I'm not your...—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wait at the spot where I parted ways with Espoir City.
Meanwhile, the clouds steadily grow thicker...
choice_data_list: ...It's snow
...Ah, snow.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
Dammit............, I'm back!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Open it! It's yours, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Mm!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the envelope that had been thrust upon me without room for refusal.
Inside was a single sheet of paper—
choice_data_list: A "Ticket to Show the Strongest"...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I swear I'll show you, you bastard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No matter where you are! No matter what you're doing!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show 'em!
Definitely... without a damn doubt!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The Espoir City who was by your side!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Snow falls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of the ticket she gave me,
one by one, the snowflakes melt away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The words she gave me begin to blur.
choice_data_list: ...You're really cool, you know that?
...You really are so cool.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You know that better than anyone, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's head back, Trainer.
Your nose is bright red."
choice_data_list: ...Same goes for you, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...'Cause it's freezin'.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It's just because it's cold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, I took off my scarf and handed it to her
so she could stay a little warmer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wrapped it back around my neck roughly, yet with a touch of gentleness.
The sound of both of us sniffling echoed under the chilly sky.
